stops.name: Geneva: death, and burial at the Cimetière des Rois
stops.campa: He dies in Geneva on 1 July 1950, five days short of his eighty-fifth birthday, and is buried in the Cimetière des Rois, the city's resting place for its most honored dead. The Institut on the Terrassière continues without him, as Hellerau once tried and failed to continue; the method he built from a mother's Pestalozzian conviction, an Algiers drum, and a Conservatoire's stumbling fingers has by now crossed every ocean his pupils were willing to cross. Geneva, which took in the Vienna-born family of a clock-salesman in 1875, keeps him in its ground for good.
